notes.body:
Empagliflozin body model
Distribution of empagliflozin and its glucuronide (EG) with the blood flow, the tissue distribution of empagliflozin into a fast and a deep pool, the hepatic and renal glucuronidation, the absorption and fecal excretion and the renal excretion of empagliflozin and EG.
The content of this model has been carefully created in a manual research effort.

body.p: Empagliflozin and EG in the plasma, compared with the total radioactivity of the plasma.
Empagliflozin and EG in the urine, compared with the total radioactivity of the urine.
Empagliflozin in the feces, compared with the total radioactivity of the feces (the oxidative metabolites of the feces, 3.6 % of the dose [Chen2015a], are not modelled).

Fasting plasma glucose (FPG), set by the studies. It shifts the RTG (SGLT2 is induced in type 2 diabetes) and, with the difference of the mean plasma glucose of the day to the FPG (PG_delta), gives the glucose which is filtered.
Body weight at which the exchange flows of the tissue distribution (ftissue_<sid>) are given; they scale with the body weight as the volumes, the blood flows and the renal clearance do.
1.0: normal function; <1.0: reduced function as reduced cardiac output;

parameter.name: rest of body fractional tissue volume

body.p: Assumed FQgu is the sum of FQgu + FQsp + FQpa for correct portal blood flow. with FQgu=0.146, FQsp=0.017, FQpa=0.017

parameter.name: hepatic (venous side) fractional tissue blood flow
rest of body fractional tissue blood flow
fraction of portal venous blood shunted by the liver
fraction of lost parenchymal liver volume

body.p: GFR per renal blood flow (76.3 ml/l, a ratio of 0.0763). Calibrated so that the healthy GFR is 101 ml/min at the renal blood flow of 1.32354 l/min of 75 kg, the normal GFR of the classes of renal impairment (pkpdsim.impairment).
The GFR of healthy kidneys, which scales with the renal blood flow and so with the body weight; the GFR is KI__f_renal_function times this rate.

Scaling factor of the glucuronidation of empagliflozin (UGT2B7, UGT1A3, UGT1A8, UGT1A9) of the liver and the kidney; an inducer or inhibitor changes both. 1.0: normal activity; <1.0 decreased activity; >1.0 increased activity.

parameter.name: rate of the hepatic glucuronidation of empagliflozin

body.p: First-order rate of the hepatic clearance of empagliflozin by uptake (OATP1B1/1B3) and glucuronidation, relative to the volume of the liver tissue (LI__EMP2EG_k of the liver). Empagliflozin is far below the Km of the UGTs, its pharmacokinetics are dose proportional from 0.5 to 200 mg [Seman2013]. The renal glucuronidation is f_ugt_renal of the glucuronidation of both organs.
The value of EMP2EG_k is the result of the fit PK_20261019_201013__13ddc, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

Fraction of the glucuronidation of empagliflozin in the kidney at normal renal and hepatic function, the rest is hepatic. The split is not identified by the data of healthy subjects; it is the one which gives the exposure in hepatic and in renal impairment together: the AUC ratios of severe hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh C, 1.75 [Macha2014b]) and of severe renal impairment (eGFR 15-29, 1.67 [Macha2014f]) are reached with 30 % of the glucuronidation in the kidney, which scales with the renal function.

parameter.name: rate of the renal glucuronidation of empagliflozin

body.p: First-order rate of the renal glucuronidation relative to the volume of the kidney (KI__EMP2EG_k of the kidney), from the hepatic rate and the renal fraction f_ugt_renal.

parameter.name: Cumulative dose due to infusion emp

blockquote.p: 1.0: increased kidney function 1.0: normal kidney function (healthy control) <1.0: decreased kidney function

body.p: Renal function relative to the healthy glomerular filtration rate GFR_base, which is 101 ml/min at 75 kg; a measured creatinine clearance or GFR of X ml/min is the renal function X/101. It scales the filtration (renal excretion, glucose excretion) and the renal glucuronidation (the functional renal mass).

Scaling factor of the basolateral uptake of empagliflozin into the proximal tubule by OAT3: the tubular secretion and the renal glucuronidation. Probenecid, an inhibitor of OAT1/OAT3, lowers the renal clearance of empagliflozin from 32.7 to 15.2 ml/min, the filtration of the unbound fraction [Macha2014]. 1.0: normal activity; <1.0 inhibited.
Empagliflozin is 80-86 % bound to plasma proteins [Chen2015a, Macha2014f], independent of the renal function.

parameter.name: tubular secretion of empagliflozin relative to its filtration

body.p: The renal clearance of empagliflozin is the filtration of its unbound fraction, fu_emp * GFR (14 ml/min), and the tubular secretion by OAT3, EMPSEC_f times the filtration. The renal clearance of 28-39 ml/min [Seman2013, Sarashina2013, Macha2014] is about twice the filtration.
The value of KI__EMPSEC_f is the result of the fit PK_20261019_201013__13ddc, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

parameter.name: renal clearance of EG relative to the GFR

body.p: The renal clearance of the glucuronides is EGEX_f times the GFR; the glucuronides are about 0.2 of empagliflozin in the plasma (17.7 % vs 79.6 % of the radioactivity, AUC 0-12 hr) [Chen2015a], their kinetics are limited by their formation.
The value of KI__EGEX_f is the result of the fit PK_20261019_201013__13ddc, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

parameter.name: mean plasma glucose of the day minus the fasting plasma glucose

body.p: The glucose which is filtered over the day is the mean plasma glucose of the day, above the fasting plasma glucose by the meals. In healthy subjects the 24-hr mean plasma glucose is 5.6-5.7 mM [Seman2013, Sarashina2013], 0.7 mM above a fasting plasma glucose of 5 mM. Studies which report the 24-hr mean plasma glucose set the difference to the FPG.

EC50 of the reduction of the RTG by plasma empagliflozin (total). The IC50 of empagliflozin for human SGLT2 is 3.1 nM [Grempler2012]; SGLT2 is inhibited from the tubular lumen, where empagliflozin is concentrated by the filtration, the secretion and the reabsorption of water. The urinary glucose excretion of 1 mg is a third of the maximal one [Sarashina2013]; the fit gives about 4 nM total plasma empagliflozin (0.6 nM unbound).
The value of KI__RTG_E50 is the result of the fit PD_20261019_212349__c28ac, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

RTG without SGLT2 inhibition in healthy subjects (FPG 5 mM), which corresponds to the SGLT2 capacity; about 10-11 mM (180-200 mg/dl).
The value of KI__RTG_base is the result of the fit PD_20261019_212349__c28ac, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

Increase of the RTG per mM of FPG above the healthy FPG: SGLT2 is induced in type 2 diabetes [Rahmoune2005]. Phenomenological: it gives the urinary glucose excretion of type 2 diabetes (78-102 g with 25-50 mg [Heise2013, Sarashina2014, Macha2014f]) with the constant glucose of the model, which has no fall of the glucose during the treatment.
The value of KI__RTG_m_fpg is the result of the fit PD_20261019_212349__c28ac, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

body.p: Maximal reduction of the RTG by SGLT2 inhibition relative to the RTG without inhibition: SGLT1 reabsorbs the glucose which SGLT2 does not.
The value of KI__RTG_max_inhibition is the result of the fit PD_20261019_212349__c28ac, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

parameter.name: splay of the glucose excretion around the RTG

body.p: The thresholds of the nephrons differ, so the glucose excretion rises smoothly around the RTG (splay) instead of at a sharp threshold; the softplus with a width of 1 mM.

parameter.name: mean plasma glucose of the day

body.p: Scaling factor of the hepatic uptake of empagliflozin by OATP1B1 and OATP1B3, the rate determining step of the hepatic clearance. 1.0: normal activity; <1.0 inhibited (rifampicin, gemfibrozil).

Fraction absorbed: F_emp_abs of the empagliflozin of the intestinal lumen is absorbed, (1 - F_emp_abs) is excreted in the feces. The absolute bioavailability is not known; the radioactivity of the urine (54.4 %) and the oxidative metabolites of the feces (3.6 %) give a fraction absorbed of about 0.58 of the oral solution [Chen2015a].
The value of GU__F_emp_abs is the result of the fit PK_20261019_201013__13ddc, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

First-order rate of the empagliflozin leaving the lumen, absorbed (F_emp_abs) or to the fecal transit: tmax 1.0-1.5 hr fasted [Seman2013, Heise2013].
The value of GU__EMPABS_k is the result of the fit PK_20261019_201013__13ddc, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

Transit of the empagliflozin which is not absorbed through the intestine into the feces, n_chain steps with this rate (mean transit time of about 70 hr): 10.9, 29.0, 37.9 and 39.9 % of the dose in the feces at 48, 72, 96 and 120 hr [Chen2015a].
The value of GU__METEXC_k is the result of the fit PK_20261019_201013__13ddc, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

The dose is taken in the fasted state (0) or with a meal (1). The effect of food on the absorption rate is FED_f_absorption.

parameter.name: fed effect on the absorption rate

body.p: Factor of the absorption rate with food: Cmax 0.71 and the AUC 0.90 of the fasted state, tmax 2.5 instead of 1.0 hr [Seman2013]; Cmax 0.80, AUC 0.95 [Chen2020]. The fraction absorbed is not changed.
The value of GU__FED_f_absorption is the result of the fit PK_20261019_201013__13ddc, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

assignmentRule.name: rate of the renal glucuronidation of empagliflozin

body.p: log(2) ~ 0.693 used for conversion of half-life injection time to injection rate.

assignmentRule.name: mean plasma glucose of the day

body.p: The glucose which is filtered.
FPG dependent RTG without SGLT2 inhibition. SGLT2 is induced in T2DM [Rahmoune2005].
Renal threshold glucose.

The renal threshold for glucose (RTG) is the plasma glucose concentration at which the tubular reabsorption of glucose begins to saturate; glucose is excreted into the urine in proportion to the glucose concentration above this threshold.
Urinary glucose excretion, the cumulative amount of glucose in the urine.
The glucuronidation of the empagliflozin of the renal plasma after the uptake by OAT3; the export of EG is fast.
The filtered glucose above the RTG, the softplus of the difference with the width RTG_splay: the excretion approaches GFR * (pg - RTG) above the RTG and zero below it.
Uptake of the empagliflozin of the plasma of the liver and its glucuronidation; the export of EG into the plasma is fast.
Swallowing, dissolution of tablet, and transport into intestine. Overall process describing the rates of this processes.
